Definition: from G1349; equitable (in character or act); by implication, innocent, holy (absolutely or relatively):--just, meet, right(-eous).
BiblicalUsage: The righteous person is the one who is right with God and does what is right, like Joseph, who would not expose Mary, and the sheep who inherit eternal life. Paul's great claim is that the just shall live by faith, and John calls Jesus Christ the righteous advocate who pleads for us.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe righteousness is first a gift and then a life. Christ is righteous for me before God, and His Spirit makes me righteous in practice, so that the verdict and the walk belong together.
RelatedTopics: Righteousness; Righteousness of God; Justification by faith
